label: impl:1:1
cmd: python3 -c "import sys,json,tempfile,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'skills/ultrapowers/scripts'); import plan_check as pc; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); p=d/'plan.md'; p.write_text('# x\n'); r=d/'plan.gate-verdicts.json'; r.write_text(json.dumps({'tasks':{},'tally':{'dispatched':3,'rejected':1},'authoring':{'minutes':118,'probes':12,'routing':{'branch':'risk','lane':'ultrapowers'},'questions':[{'question':'Claim','options':['A','B'],'recommended':'A','picked':'A','explain_rounds':2},{'question':'Execute','options':['A','B'],'recommended':'A','picked':'B'}]}})); line=pc.authoring_fact_line(p); assert line.endswith('2 questions, 1/2 recommended picked, 2 explain rounds'), line; assert pc.authoring_record_violations(p)==[]; r.write_text(json.dumps({'tasks':{},'tally':{},'authoring':{'minutes':1,'probes':0,'routing':{'branch':'inline','lane':'inline'},'questions':[{'question':'Claim','options':['A','B'],'recommended':'A','picked':'A','explain_rounds':-1}]}})); v=pc.authoring_record_violations(p); assert len(v)==1 and 'questions[0].explain_rounds' in v[0], v; print('fact line ok')"

label: impl:1:1
cmd: python3 -c "import json,tempfile,pathlib,subprocess,sys; d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); a={'minutes':5,'probes':0,'routing':{'branch':'inline','lane':'inline'}}; (d/'run-1').mkdir(); (d/'run-1'/'gate-verdicts.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tasks':{},'tally':{'dispatched':1,'rejected':0},'authoring':{**a,'questions':[{'question':'q','options':['A','B'],'recommended':'A','picked':'A','explain_rounds':2},{'question':'r','options':['A','B'],'recommended':None,'picked':'B','explain_rounds':1}]}})); (d/'run-2').mkdir(); (d/'run-2'/'gate-verdicts.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tasks':{},'tally':{'dispatched':1,'rejected':0},'authoring':{**a,'questions':[{'question':'q','options':['A','B'],'recommended':'A','picked':'A'}]}})); out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'skills/ultrawrite/scripts/authoring_census.py','--from',str(d)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines(); assert out[0].split('\t')[-1]=='explain_rounds', out[0]; assert out[1].split('\t')[-1]=='3' and out[2].split('\t')[-1]=='0', out[1:3]; assert out[-1].startswith('totals: ') and out[-1].endswith(' explain_rounds=3'), out[-1]; print('census ok')"
